restated: An adversary with existing access to compromised Windows hosts is using remote execution or authentication mechanisms to pivot to additional hosts on the network.
what_would_confirm: Remote service creation or SMB/PsExec/WinRM/RDP/SSH logons from a compromised host to other hosts, remote scheduled task or WMI execution, pass-the-hash/ticket authentication to new hosts, or service/process artifacts on destination hosts originating from the source host.
what_would_refute: No remote logons or remote execution events originating from compromised hosts to other hosts, no new host-to-host authentication or service creation, and no evidence of credential reuse or remote session establishment beyond normal baseline.
